The shared native Lightbox is not yet ported, so the local component (RN Modal, animationType='fade', transparent, onRequestClose=onClose for Android back) reproduces the web Lightbox core verbatim: the safeInitialIndex clamp = Math.min(Math.max(initialIndex,0),Math.max(total-1,0)) (web L102), the closed->open index reset via wasOpenRef (web L113-121), goPrev=setIndex(i=>Math.max(0,i-1)) (web L243-244), goNext=setIndex(i=>Math.min(total-1,i+1)) (web L246-247), the `if (!open || total === 0) return null` + `const current = images[Math.min(index, total-1)]` + `if (!current) return null` guards (web L344-348), the counter t('lightbox.counter','{{current}} / {{total}}',{current:index+1,total}) (web L413-416), the close button t('lightbox.close','Close image viewer') (web L421), the prev/next controls rendered only when total>1 (web L466) disabled at atFirst/atLast (web L471/L488) with t('lightbox.previous','Previous image')/t('lightbox.next','Next image') (web L472/L489), and the caption row {current.caption ? ... : null} (web L508-515). Backdrop-tap-to-close (web L378-387 div aria-hidden onClick=onClose) -> an absoluteFill Pressable (accessibilityElementsHidden) under a pointerEvents='box-none' content layer so image-area gap taps fall through to close, exactly like the web pointer-events-none dialog + pointer-events-auto children. The web Lightbox's zoom(1x-5x)+pan, ArrowLeft/Right keyboard nav, DOM focus-trap, createPortal, and neighbour-image pre-warm are browser-leaning extras that belong to the Lightbox's own future per-file native pass and are intentionally out of scope for this display-only wrapper (which only needs open/navigate/close); their i18n keys are not invoked here.
